Yes, this is exactly the reversible option I'd been asking for. Setting the pasta bookmark aside made it vanish from my main list, it showed up safely in the "Set aside" view, and restoring it brought it right back to my collection with everything intact — its details, tags, my formatted note, and the read-later flag all still there. Nothing lost.

And your assumptions match what I want: setting aside is easily undone, so it doesn't need a confirmation prompt the way permanent delete does — that difference is right. And while something's set aside, I'd want it out of my main list and out of my everyday search so it's not cluttering things, but still reachable in its own view when I go looking for it. That's the gentle "tuck it away" I wanted, clearly separate from deleting for good. Good — this matches my intent. Let's keep going.
